Do not till, tilling breaks up top soil put creates an impenetrable layer below the surface and water will soak even slower. I would recommend watching permaculture videos on YouTube. One of the key tenets of permaculture is controlling naturally occurring water on your land, recognizing contour lines and gradation on your property. You can learn how to move water using keylines and swales which will keep your land looking more natural then digging ditches and trenches. Creating a pond could less of digging a big hole and more like building a dam or berm. Geoff lawton and Jack Spirko have some pretty good videos on earthworks and water control. The resources are available for you to educate yourself before paying a "professional" or just digging trenches and hoping for the best. Good luck, I hope this is helpful.
